text: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
The sword has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. When you hit a creature with it, you can expend 1 charge to let out a howl: the target takes an extra 1d6 Thunder damage.

text: While holding this Shield, you have a +1 bonus to Armor Class. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
If the Shield is more than 30 feet from you, it bounds back to your hand at the start of your next turn.

kennel:magic.kennelguard-mail.name: Kennelguard Mail, +1, +2, or +3
kennel:magic.kennelguard-mail.description: Armor (any medium or heavy), rarity varies

text: Stitched with a guard dog's patience, this armor gives a bonus to Armor Class while you wear it. The bonus is determined by its rarity.
While wearing this studded leather collar, you have a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws. Tough outside, good inside.
While wearing these shaggy bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class if you are wearing no armor and using no Shield.

kennel:magic.howling-pendant.name: Howling Pendant
kennel:magic.howling-pendant.description: Rare wondrous item, requires attunement by a Bard, Druid, or Ranger

text: Your Wisdom score is 17 while you wear this wolf's-tooth pendant. It has no effect on you if your Wisdom is already 17 or higher.

The pendant has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge to howl, and every ally within 30 feet of you who can hear you gains 1d4 Temporary Hit Points.

uses.description: Expend 1 charge to howl: every ally within 30 feet of you who can hear you gains 1d4 Temporary Hit Points.

text: While this bone whistle hangs around your neck, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks.
The whistle has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend 1 charge to cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13) from it.
While you wear this heavy fur mantle, you have Resistance to Cold damage and Darkvision out to 60 feet.
